title: Photos and video
description: What happens with photos and video from the event, how consents work and how to ask for restriction of likeness publication.
subtitle: What is photographed at the event, how it is used, and how to ask for restrictions.
intro_pre: There are agreed photographers and videographers at the event. They take footage for
intro_strong: event documentation, promotion of future editions, the association’s social media and the community photo gallery
intro_post: . Participants also take their own photos.
layer_official_desc: Photos and video taken by the organiser or appointed photographers. Used for the website, social media and edition promotion.
layer_private_desc: Participants take photos for their own memories and community sharing. No commercial use.
layer_commercial_desc: For journalists, media use, business purposes. Requires prior agreement with the organisers and the photographers’ own consents from the people captured.
consent_p1_pre: By registering for the event you consent to the taking of photos and video for the
consent_p1_strong: documentation and promotion of the event
consent_p1_post: by the organiser. This consent does not include secondary commercial use by third parties.
consent_p2_pre: If you have a serious reason for not wanting to be recognisable in promotional photos (e.g. professional context, privacy),
consent_p2_post: or report it directly at on-site registration.
minors_l1_pre: The photo consent is part of the
minors_l2_pre: If the legal guardian does not consent to taking or publishing the child’s likeness, it must be
minors_l2_post: in the application or communicated at registration.
minors_l3: For children we place extra emphasis on consideration — we don’t photograph or share insensitive situations.
rules_intro_pre: Are you a photographer or videographer coming to document the event? The full rules overview is in the section
rules_l1: The game and players always take priority — you don’t obstruct or disturb.
rules_l2: The costume requirement also applies to photographers and videographers.
rules_l3: Drones only by prior agreement with the organisers.
rules_l4: Commercial use of taken photos requires your own consents from the people captured.
request_p: If you see your photo on our website or social media and don’t want it to remain there, write us:
request_response: Include the URL or attach the specific photo. We reply within 30 days at the latest and will remove or replace the photo where possible.
